import glob
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess

for link in glob.glob("/tmp/bench67480710/var/log/containers/*.log"):
    raw = subprocess.run(["sudo", "cat", os.path.realpath(link)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    with open("/tmp/bench67480710/converted/" + os.path.basename(link), "w") as out:
        for line in raw.splitlines():
            m = re.match(r"^(\S+) (stdout|stderr) [FP] (.*)$", line)
            out.write(json.dumps({"log": m.group(3), "stream": m.group(2), "time": m.group(1)}) + "\n")
PY
